Databricks SQL Dashboards: Real‑time operational analytics at scale. In production I built a multi‑tenant dashboard layer using CREATE DASHBOARD on a Databricks SQL endpoint, pulling from Delta Lake tables with SELECT * FROM health_events WHERE event_date = CURRENT_DATE(). I tuned the warehouse with ALTER WAREHOUSE SET AUTO_SUSPEND = 60 and AUTO_RESUME = TRUE, achieving sub‑5‑second query latency for 10k+ concurrent users.
